primitive: SHA-256; raw working-state measurements are explicitly distinguished from final digests
coordinates: MSB-first input bit; W index = bit//32; round is completed compression rounds

graphs.state: working registers after 64 rounds before feed-forward

avalanche.selection: bottom 22 input positions by raw mean Hamming distance at round 24 in discovery only
avalanche.estimand: holdout selected minus other positions in message word W0, and across all message bits; bases are replication units

search.metric: minimum raw Hamming distance over the 15 two-bit patterns; equal budgets

cubes.control_pool: six distinct bits uniformly drawn from W0, equal injection time
cubes.observable: XOR sum of bit 16 counted LSB-first in register a; zero rate

models: PCA:50 train-only components + RBF SVM C=1 gamma=scale
ml.observable: actual hashlib SHA-256 digests of random 55-byte messages vs independent PCG64 bit strings

inference.graph: paired mean SHA-minus-random differences over independently seeded dataset pairs; interval descriptive, not multiplicity adjusted
inference.cube: paired base-level difference, target versus average of 20 equal-entry random sets; percentile bootstrap; Holm adjustment over eight round-wise exact target binomial tests
inference.negative_results: absence of evidence for these observables, not security or general indistinguishability
